title: Scheme locally complete intersection over a field
statement: For a field $k$ and a $k$-scheme $X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-affine-spectrum], using the scheme-level predicate of [lem-trf-syntomic-geometric-fibres-affine-criterion], the scheme is locally a complete intersection over $k$ if it has an affine open cover whose coordinate rings are finite type local complete intersections over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-complete-intersection-over-field]. For a field embedding $\varphi:k\to\Omega$, the same condition after scalar extension $X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ [def-pc-fibre-product] can be expressed by an affine open cover $(U_i)$ of $X$ for which the canonical scalar-extended coordinate rings $\Omega\otimes_k\Gamma(U_i,\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product] are finite type local complete intersections over $\Omega$; this formulation also permits $\Omega$ to live in a larger universe than $X$. Empty schemes and empty covers are allowed.

source.place: Definition 10.135.1, Tag 00S9; Morphisms Tag 01UG (lemma-local-complete-intersection); Schemes Tags 01JR/01JQ for base-changed charts, with Algebra Tag 00SJ
